description: Uva Province - Order made to appoint Mrs. H. M. D. Jayalath and four other Official Members and Six other members and to appoint Attorney L. K. Ajith Kumara as the Chairman of the Uva Province Public Transport Service Authority
categorisation: This gazette names specific individuals (Mrs. H. M. D. Jayalath, Miss Sajani Puemila, etc.) being appointed to the Uva Province public transport service authority AND outlines their detailed responsibilities/roles within that government authority structure. It contains both the "who" (government personnel) and the "what" (specific government responsibilities and appointments), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
